## Project title

Portfolio Website Traffic and Engagement Analysis

## Data and source

The project will use traffic and engagement data from Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console. I plan to have Search Console index the site, connect it to GA4, send GA4 data to BigQuery, and summarize the results in Looker Studio.

## Managerial problem

I need to understand how visitors find the portfolio, which pages they view, and where they stop engaging before I can improve the site.

## Target audience

I am the main audience for the report. The finished project can also show prospective employers how I measure and report website performance.

## Research questions and objectives

- Which channels bring visitors to the portfolio?
- Which pages receive the most traffic and engagement?
- How do visitors move between the home, project, and résumé pages?
- Which content or navigation changes may improve engagement?

## Expected impact

The analysis should help me improve the portfolio's content, navigation, and search visibility.

## Planned methods

I plan to compare traffic sources, pages, devices, trends, and conversion events. I will use BigQuery for queries, Looker Studio for the dashboard, and Quarto for the final report after enough data have been collected.
